text:
Maya: noticed a weird delta between console 'heartbeat_missed' and proxy logs — console spikes but proxy doesn't show pingback_timeout.
Kevin: can you paste the alert window? is this across regions or single region?
Maya: eu-west mostly, 5–10% of streams over a 10m window. alert query: `sum by(zone)(increase(heartbeat_missed[10m]))` vs proxy logs showing `pingback_timeout` ~0.
Alex: interesting — could be metric tag mismatch. console pipeline uses `session_origin` tag, proxy emits `source_zone`. dashboards join on different keys so they fall through.
Jin: that's been our problem before. we have two schemas. who owns the mapping? console or proxy?
Lina: mapping should live in ingest (metrics-transform) not in proxy. cheap to add a mapper there and keep proxy stable.
Kevin: agree re: single source of truth. but we also need historical continuity for alerts. if we rename tags naive alerts will fire.
Maya: proposal: add a compatibility tag for 2 weeks: `session_origin || source_zone as session_origin_compat` then flip after 2w.
Alex: +1. add a small flag to metrics-transform to emit both keys. and update dashboard queries to prefer `session_origin` if present.
Jin: another thing — reconnects during those spikes triggered duplicate billing for resumed streams. billing shows resume_id null in some cases.
Maya: repro snippet: client reconnects -> server issues resume_token but proxy sometimes drops header and new session billed as fresh.
Kevin: are we sure header is dropped in proxy and not in LB? need trace.
Alex: grabbed trace: `X-Resume-Id` is set by control-plane but proxy strips it when request goes through health-check path. bad routing rule.
Lina: that's a config bug. quick fix: whitelist `X-Resume-Id` in proxy passthrough for all streaming endpoints.
Jin: long term: make resume-id idempotency at billing side — prefer `resume_id` header if present and ignore immediate token-less sessions within 10s.
Maya: agreed. also need telemetry: expose `resume_id_source` metric (proxy|lb|control) for debugging billing joins.
sre-bot: deploy 1777654400: metrics-transform v2.1.1 -> added session_origin_compat emission. :rocket:
Kevin: thanks. action items:
- Lina: patch proxy config to whitelist `X-Resume-Id` (hotfix)
- Alex: add `resume_id_source` metric and dashboard panel
- Jin: billing guard to de-dupe resume-less sessions for 10s window
- Maya: update alerts to use compatibility tag and annotate migration timeline
Maya: can someone own rollout messaging? console UX needs a little blurb explaining we temporarily emit both tags to avoid alert noise.
Lina: I'll handle the hotfix now, ping me if you see regressions.
Alex: I'll add dashboard panel, will attach queries once live.
Jin: I'll start a PR for billing guard, tag @kevin for review.
Maya: thanks team. follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
